header.title: Neuro-Psychological Treatment
header.subtitle: Comprehensive assessment and therapy for cognitive, behavioral, and emotional challenges linked to brain-based conditions.

imageAlt: A calm, quiet room set up for focused one-on-one therapy

overview.title: Care that connects the brain and behavior
paragraphs: Neuro-psychological treatment addresses how brain function affects memory, attention, learning, mood, and behavior — often following an injury, developmental condition, or age-related change.
Our clinicians combine structured cognitive testing with therapy, so treatment is grounded in a clear picture of your strengths and challenges.
We work closely with neurologists, psychiatrists, and schools where needed, so care stays coordinated across every part of your treatment.
